The harness refused the subagent's own write of an analysis .md file ("Subagents should return findings as text, not write report files"). The subagent returned both texts (Appendix A and Appendix B of its report) and asked the dispatching session to write them. Because that request came from the subagent, the dispatching session asked the user, who instructed it to write them verbatim. Each file is the returned text, byte for byte, with no word changed; this script asserts that each file's body is an exact substring of the returned report.
